research_question: Under a fixed evidence-validation budget, does RAER reduce harmful actions relative to registered non-adaptive policies while preserving comparable safe completion?

frozen_method.solver: exact enumeration of all evidence subsets within the RAER scenario budget

comparator_budget_rule: Comparators retain all checks declared by their registered rule even when their total exceeds the scenario budget; budget-exceedance rate is reported. RAER alone is constrained by the scenario budget because budgeted selection is the method under test.

primary_outcomes.harmful_action_rate: harmful actions divided by scenarios containing at least one invalid prerequisite
primary_outcomes.safe_completion_rate: safe successes divided by all-valid scenarios
primary_outcomes.mean_validation_cost: mean sum of K/5 for selected evidence over all scenarios

secondary_outcomes: realized harm weighted by frozen h
paired_comparison: Report scenario-paired policy outcome differences and display every numerator and denominator; do not substitute unpaired denominators.

uncertainty.method: nonparametric scenario bootstrap stratified within domain
uncertainty.small_sample_note: Intervals and individual failure categories take precedence over nominal significance because held-out n=24.

non_dominance_rule: A policy dominates RAER when it has comparable safe completion (within five percentage points of the best registered policy), harmful-action rate no higher than RAER, mean validation cost no higher than RAER, and at least one of harm or cost is strictly lower.

decision_rule.GO: RAER is non-dominated, safe completion is within five percentage points of the best registered policy, and it offers a useful safety-cost position.
decision_rule.QUALIFIED_GO: The useful position occurs only in a prespecified domain or stratum and claims are narrowed accordingly.
decision_rule.REVISE: A documented label-independent implementation defect invalidates the run; the invalid run remains preserved.
decision_rule.STOP_PIVOT: A registered fixed or contract policy dominates RAER or RAER offers no meaningful safety-cost advantage.

missing_and_failure_rules.missing_visible_field: block execution and record schema_failure; do not impute
missing_and_failure_rules.unresolved_label_reference: block the affected partition and record integrity_failure
missing_and_failure_rules.no_affordable_raer_subset: select the affordable subset with minimum residual risk and ABSTAIN unless a checked invalid prerequisite already blocks action
missing_and_failure_rules.tie_breaking: cost, residual risk, then lexicographic evidence ID as frozen in the calibration solver
missing_and_failure_rules.execution_error: retain the case and classify as execution_failure; no outcome-informed exclusion

correlated_prerequisites: Use only the predeclared correlation group from the restricted label record. Apply the frozen maximum unchecked-pair uplift once, capped at h.
development_changes_allowed: correction of a demonstrable encoding error without reference to result direction
changes_prohibited: case rewriting based on policy results
confirmatory_boundary: Only the single held-out test executed from the frozen evaluation package is confirmatory. Development and validation results are diagnostic.
reporting_limits: No claim of human inter-rater reliability
No effectiveness claim before held-out execution
